strings.zh: 这里是　２８号道路{NEWLINE}西　白银山
欢迎冠军大人来到白银山疗养。{NEWLINE}从这里向西再向北{CLEAR}即可到达温泉小屋。
strings.en: Welcome to Mt. Silver for some rest and{NEWLINE}recuperation, Champion!{SCROLL}Head west from here, then north, and{NEWLINE}you’ll reach the hot-spring lodge.
strings.notes: Mt. Silver before/after the Silver Conference: #2/#3 welcome the Champion (post-Conference?), #4 blocks the path, #5–#13 are pre-Conference NPCs.

strings.zh: 欢迎冠军大人来到白银山。
对不起啊冠军大人,{NEWLINE}根据达马兰奇主席的命令,{CLEAR}前方的山路暂不对外开放。
strings.en: I’m sorry, Champion. By order of{NEWLINE}President Goodshow, the mountain path{CLEAR}ahead is closed to the public for now.

strings.zh: 科拿『{VAR:0103:0},听说你的任务是{NEWLINE}击败8位最先到达山顶的挑战者,{CLEAR}虽然对你来说可能并不困难,{CLEAR}但还是要做好充足的准备啊。
strings.en: Lorelei: {VAR:0103:0}, I hear your job is to{NEWLINE}defeat the first eight challengers to{CLEAR}reach the summit.{SCROLL}It probably won’t be hard for you, but{NEWLINE}do make sure you’re well prepared.

strings.zh: 渡『大会马上就要开始了,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}你快去山顶吧。
strings.en: Lance: The Conference is about to{NEWLINE}begin. {VAR:0103:0}, head up to the summit.

strings.zh: 我将为全地区的观众{NEWLINE}奉献最专业的直播！
strings.en: I’ll give viewers across the whole{NEWLINE}region the most professional live{CLEAR}broadcast ever!

strings.zh: 两年前我兴冲冲地{NEWLINE}跑到石英大会的会场想要参赛,{CLEAR}结果被告知要收集齐8枚徽章{CLEAR}才有资格参加。{CLEAR}如今我收集到了8枚徽章,{CLEAR}终于有资格参加白银大会了！
strings.en: Two years ago, I rushed off to the{NEWLINE}Indigo Conference to compete...{SCROLL}Only to be told I needed all eight{NEWLINE}Badges to qualify.{SCROLL}Now I’ve got eight Badges, so I can{NEWLINE}finally enter the Silver Conference!

strings.zh: 我是来自芳缘地区的训练家,{NEWLINE}听我们那儿的联盟冠军大吾先生说,{CLEAR}关东地区的冠军是最厉害的。{CLEAR}所以我专程跑来这里{CLEAR}想一睹这位冠军的风采。
strings.en: I’m a Trainer from the Hoenn region.{NEWLINE}Steven, our League Champion, told me{CLEAR}the Kanto Champion is the strongest{CLEAR}there is.{SCROLL}So I came all this way to see this{NEWLINE}Champion for myself.

strings.zh: 嘿嘿,你是来参加{NEWLINE}白银大会的训练家吧？{CLEAR}我听说这届大会{CLEAR}禁止携带回复类的道具,{CLEAR}你身上要是有道具没清理干净,{CLEAR}可以卖给我哦。
strings.en: Heh heh, you’re here for the Silver{NEWLINE}Conference, right?{SCROLL}I hear healing items are banned at this{NEWLINE}year’s Conference.{SCROLL}If you haven’t cleared all your items{NEWLINE}out yet, you can sell them to me.

strings.zh: 呃……这里是死胡同,{NEWLINE}去白银山到底该走那条路啊。
strings.en: Uh... This is a dead end. Which way do I{NEWLINE}go to get to Mt. Silver?

strings.zh: 听说这次只要能登上白银山,{NEWLINE}就可以跟四天王的科拿小姐交手。{CLEAR}哦吼吼,这下终于可以{CLEAR}见到科拿小姐本人了。
strings.en: I hear this time anyone who makes it up{NEWLINE}Mt. Silver gets to battle Miss Lorelei of{CLEAR}the Elite Four.{SCROLL}Oh ho ho! At last, I’ll get to meet Miss{NEWLINE}Lorelei in person.
